observations.behavior: Adds a new prop `showContextUsage` to the Thread component, allowing the caller to explicitly control whether the context usage bar is shown, rather than relying on the previous implicit live/non-live, non-scout logic.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the conditional rendering of the context usage bar. This could allow the PostHog team to independently control the context usage bar visibility, potentially for future feature toggles or different surface implementations.

observations.behavior: Adds a new prop `copyDetails` and a 'Copy details' button to the RunAlertActivity component, including clipboard functionality.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a copy-to-clipboard action for run details, including task, run, and trace IDs. This could help PostHog users and support engineers quickly share debugging information.

observations.behavior: Adds a new prop `undeliveredMessage` and a conditional message 'Your last message was not delivered.' to the RunAlertActivity component.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a conditional message for undelivered messages. This could help PostHog users understand why a message was not delivered, potentially for debugging or support purposes.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds ACTIVITY_CHAIN_MIN import and its use in the rows folding logic.
observations.posthog_connection: Defines a minimum chain length before the UI collapses tool calls into a single row; this could prevent excessive accordion nesting and preserve row identity when the activity window shifts.

observations.behavior: Removes the middlePage state and its use, replacing it with showMiddle and the new folding behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the previous pagination-by-middle-page approach with a simpler showMiddle toggle, potentially simplifying the activity window and removing a source of state-dependent rendering complexity.

observations.behavior: Removes the failures filter and the showFailures state, no longer separating failed calls into a dedicated list.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the failure handling strategy; failed calls are no longer collected into a separate failures list, which could affect how the UI presents and paginates failed tool invocations.
